# Northeast Basecamp

Northeast Basecamp provides Hornbill Festival campsite stays and travel support in Nagaland.

## Current festival stays

- Hornbill Festival 2026, Kisama, Nagaland: campsite stay requests are available at https://northeastbasecamp.com/festival-booking.html
- Hornbill Festival campsite stays include Dome Tent, Alpine Tent, Premium Tent and Bring Your Own Tent options, subject to availability.
- Festival tickets are not included unless a written confirmation says otherwise.

## Booking

The booking flow collects the guest name, mobile number, Hornbill check-in date, checkout date, tent category and guest count. It calculates the stay total, stores the booking request in Northeast Basecamp's database and generates a booking-request invoice immediately. This invoice is not a payment receipt; availability and any payment instructions are confirmed by the Basecamp team. For availability or stay inclusions, contact Northeast Basecamp on WhatsApp at +91 87199 62147.

## Stay standards

Northeast Basecamp focuses on comfortable tent stays, clean bedding, clean concrete toilets with three scheduled cleanings daily, guest check-in support, community zones, local culture immersion and practical festival travel guidance. Exact tent category, location, transportation, food and other inclusions are confirmed in writing for every stay.

## Festival information

- Hornbill Festival is held at Naga Heritage Village, Kisama, Nagaland. Check official Hornbill Festival channels for final dates, entry and programme information.
- Northeast Basecamp is not the Hornbill Festival organiser. Festival tickets are separate unless a written package confirmation says otherwise.
